data.exact_reserve_text:
The reduction in Financial Investments and Cash and Gross Technical provisions during 2022, primarily reflects the impact of the successful reinsurance to close of the 2019 year of account and the continued run-off of Syndicate 2468 through 2022.
Effective 1st January 2022, the 2019 year of account of was reinsured to close into Syndicate 3500, which is also under the management of RiverStone Managing Agency.

prior_year_events.event_name: 2019 year of account reinsured to close into Syndicate 3500
prior_year_events.impact_description: Large reduction in gross claims outstanding due to the reinsurance to close (transfer out) of 2019 & prior years to Syndicate 3500

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding reduced materially from GBP 312.493m at opening to GBP 11.200m at year end, driven principally by the reinsurance-to-close (RITC) transfer of the 2019 & prior years to Syndicate 3500 and continued run-off and favourable development. A small favourable change in estimates (c. GBP 1.104k) is also recorded. The movements are across multiple classes with releases in each statutory class shown in the technical provisions note.
raw_causal_phrases: the successful reinsurance to close of the 2019 year of account
the continued run-off of Syndicate 2468 through 2022
Change in estimates of technical provisions, including foreign exchange (1,104)

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross prior-year development (PYD) figure is presented in isolation. The technical provisions movement table includes a large 2019 & Prior transfer to Syndicate 3500 (RITC) of GBP 295.729k which materially reduced gross reserves; this transfer distorts use of the movement reconciliation for computing PYD. A small favourable change in estimates of GBP 1.104k is shown but it is combined with other movements. Gross premiums written in 2022 are effectively zero in the statutory segmental table. Where mapping from statutory class names to standard Lloyd's LOBs was ambiguous (e.g. Credit and suretyship, Miscellaneous financial loss), conservative approximate mappings were used and flagged with lower confidence.
